content: grpc-go latest stable v1.85.0 (2026-10-27, release notes verified). Its go.mod requires go 1.26.0 minimum and already depends on github.com/google/uuid v1.6.0 plus golang.org/x/sync v0.23.0 (proxy.golang.org .mod file verified) - so uuid adds zero new modules to the build graph if made direct.
